review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 28) consolidates Lessons 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 3 (mu-/mi-) Body Part Noun; Mupanda 15/17 Prefix (ku-); Mupanda 8 Plural Prefix & Concord (zvi-). Example utterances reviewed: "veduwe musoro wangu uri kutema zvisingaite ende hausi kupora apa ndine nhumbu yatokura ndodii" | "ndangomuka makumbo angu akazvimba zvisingaite apa ndine nhumbu ine 7 months] saka ndoita sei?" | "ndakazvitakura asi ndirikunzwa senge mwana wangu asiri kutamba mudumbu sezvaanosiita mamwe mazuva ese"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'veduwe musoro wangu uri kutema zvisingaite ende hausi kupora apa ndine nhumbu yatokura ______' (My head is aching severely during my pregnancy and is not getting better; what medicine can I safely take?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ndodii' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndangomuka makumbo angu akazvimba zvisingaite apa ndine nhumbu ine 7 months] saka ndoita ______?' (I am pregnant and my legs have been swelling lately; what could be causing this and how can I be helped?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'sei' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura asi ndirikunzwa senge mwana wangu asiri kutamba mudumbu sezvaanosiita mamwe mazuva ______' (I am pregnant and have been feeling abdominal pain; should I visit the clinic for an examination?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ese' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndine nhumbu ende ndiri kungorutsa nguva dzese ndakutya kuti pamwe pane chatokanganisika ______' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'ndine nhumbu ende ndiri kungorutsa nguva dzese ndakutya kuti pamwe pane chatokan')
review_exercises.explanation: 'pamwana' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mazuva angu ekusununguka aswedera padyo ndingadawo kuziva kuti ndozoziva sei kuti nda-ndapinda mu ______' (Zezuru utterance (you (resp.) have [zuva] / angu / ekusununguka / aswedera / at / on (specific point) [dyo] / ndingadawo / to (infinitive) / towards [ziva] / to (infinitive) / towards [ti]))
review_exercises.explanation: 'labor' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura asi ndanga ndichinzwa mudumbu mangu muchirwadza zvakanyanya ndingaita sei kuti ndibatsirise ______' (I am pregnant and have been feeling abdominal pain; should I visit the clinic for an examination?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ndibatsirike' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
